english: Father, I saw a light at night above the earth. The dead lie there. Did you go there? I did not go through. You are wise. The dead set fire at night in the earth. Why do they set fire? Below in the earth they (?gólonti). Shall we give fire to the dead? We shall give fire at the meal, and going we shall pour mead.
uncertain: Only the pie field of all packet items was printed; no English seen

english: Man, an eagle flies over the field. I have seen it. It flies on the right. What does the eagle indicate? Perkwunos has given us victory. We will overcome the enemies. If it flies on the left hand, what would we do? Now we go home and do not fight. We follow the spears.

Grandfather, a wolf crossed our path at dawn. Did it come from the left? It came from the left and watched me. Do you fear the wolf? I do not fear; I will call the dogs. Wolves seek sheep. Guard the sheep at night with the dogs. I will guard them and not sleep. Will you sit with me? I sit with you and rejoice.

How, father, does a mortal know the sign of the gods? He watches the birds, the sky and the fire. What does the sky say? If it thunders on the right, the gods rejoice. If it thunders on the left, are they angry? Then they are angry, and a wise man reminds the men in the village. I listen to the sky by day and by night.

Grandfather, enemies drove off our cows at night. Did I not tell you? The crane cried three times in the evening. I heard the crane and I did not heed it. Whoever does not heed the gods, his cows perish. Now what shall I do? Call your brothers and follow them. If they are many, shall we not die? Perkwunos will strike them. Do not fear.

Father, come out. A light burns in the sky. Where do you see it? I see nothing. There, above the rock, it stands. Now I saw the light. The star carries a tail. What does the star show? Our ancestor saw a star with it(?) and a great sickness came. May the gods protect us. Let us pour milk to the gods at the hearth. Let us go and still live.
uncertain: ḱóm h₂stérm̥ 'with a star' meaning unclear
